test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Given below are six sentences A-F, of which A and F are static and B-E have been jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order of the jumbled sentences.**

A. Timothy, the tiger cub was discovered by Grandfather in the Terai jungle near Dehra.

B. Grandfather picked him and brought him home.

C. One day when Grandfather was strolling in the jungle, he spotted a little tiger about 18 inches long.

D. The tiger cub was named Timothy by Grandfather and initially brought up entirely on milk.

E. The frightened animal was hiding among the intricate roots of a banyan tree.

F. Later, he was put on a diet of raw mutton and cod liver oil.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ACEBDF**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'A' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "Timothy, the tiger cub". Hence, 'A' is the first part.
 
• Sentence C will come after A because it explains the description of the tiger cub spotted by the grandfather.
 
• Sentence E will come after C because it explains the reaction of the cub when spotted by the grandfather.
 
• Sentence B will come after E because it explains what did the grandfather do with the cub.
 
• Sentence D will come after B because it explains the initial diet given by the grandfather to the cub.
 
• The sentence 'F' is the concluding part because it explains the diet followed by the cub later on.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Timothy, the tiger cub was discovered by Grandfather in the Terai jungle near Dehra. One day when Grandfather was strolling in the jungle, he spotted a little tiger about 18 inches long. The frightened animal was hiding among the intricate roots of a banyan tree. Grandfather picked him and brought him home. The tiger cub was named Timothy by Grandfather and initially brought up entirely on milk. Later, he was put on a diet of raw mutton and cod liver oil.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'A' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "बाघ शावक टिमोथी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'A' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य C, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह दादा द्वारा देखे गए बाघ के शावक का विवरण बताता है।
 
• वाक्य E, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह दादा द्वारा देखे जाने पर शावक की प्रतिक्रिया की व्याख्या करता है।
 
• वाक्य B, E के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि दादा ने शावक के साथ क्या किया।
 
• वाक्य D, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह दादा द्वारा शावक को दिए गए प्रारंभिक आहार की व्याख्या करता है।
 
• वाक्य 'F' अंतिम भाग है क्योंकि यह बाद में शावक द्वारा पालन किए जाने वाले आहार की व्याख्या करता है।

90:T271d,

The correct answer is 'ADECBF'.
